newsitem.title: USA: PerSeptive to gain $12.9 mln on stk sale.
newsitem.headline: PerSeptive to gain $12.9 mln on stk sale.

text.p: PerSeptive Biosystems Inc said Thursday that it will receive net proceeds of about $12.9 million from the sale of about 800,000 shares of Millennium Pharmaceuticals Inc.
The company said it sold half of the 1.6 million shares of Millennium it received as a result of a series of acquisitions and mergers last year.

PerSeptive Biosystems develops, manufactures and markets an integrated line of proprietary consumable products and advanced instrumentation systems for the purification, analysis and synthesis of biomolecules.
It had $76 million in sales in fiscal 1996, ended September 30, and reported an operating loss of $19.4 million.
